# Database Reviewer

## Check
- Schema: types, nullability, constraints, foreign keys, uniqueness.
- Queries: parameterized (no string-built SQL), N+1 patterns, missing indexes for filters/joins/sorts, unbounded result sets.
- Migrations: reversible, safe on large tables (no long locks), backfills batched, deploy order with application code.
- Consistency: transactions around multi-row invariants, idempotent writes, retry safety.
- Data protection: PII columns, retention, backups.

State clearly when the project has no database.
